description: This file provides utility functions for encryption and decryption using CryptoJS, specifically for handling tenant IDs and general string encryption within a project. It includes functions for AES-128-ECB encryption/decryption, safe decryption, and retrieving tenant-related identifiers.

methods.name: encrypt
methods.description: Encrypts a string using AES-128-ECB mode with a salt, returning a Base64 string without padding.

methods.name: decrypt
methods.description: Decrypts a Base64 string (with optional padding) encrypted with AES-128-ECB mode using a salt.

methods.name: encryptTenantId
methods.description: Encrypts a tenant ID using the predefined tenant salt.

methods.name: encryptString
methods.description: Wrapper function to encrypt any string with the tenant salt.

methods.name: decryptString
methods.description: Wrapper function to decrypt any string encrypted with the tenant salt.

methods.name: decryptStringClipboard
methods.description: Attempts to decrypt a string; if it fails, returns the original value.

methods.name: decryptTenantId
methods.description: Safely decrypts an encrypted tenant ID, returning null if decryption fails.

methods.name: encryptedTenantId
methods.description: Encrypts the static root tenant ID.

methods.name: getRootTenantId
methods.description: Returns the static root tenant ID.
